title: Rethinking Bayesian Optimization for Co-Optimizing LLM Training Configurations
abstract: arXiv:2602.08351v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Fine-tuning an LLM to maximize performance on a downstream task requires finding the optimal data and model configuration. This is a black-box optimization problem that Bayesian optimization (BO) addresses by sequentially evaluating training configurations and using observed performance feedback to adaptively guide the search towards better configurations. However, directly applying BO to the joint data-model space suffers from two fundamental challenges: the prohibitive cost of full LLM training at each iteration, and the large number of BO iterations required for effective exploration due to the high problem dimensionality. This paper introduces JoBS, a BO-based approach that co-optimizes data and model configurations without requiring a full training run at every iteration. translated_title: 重新思考贝叶斯优化以协同优化大语言模型训练配置
translated_abstract: 微调大语言模型（LLM）以最大化其在下游任务上的性能，需要找到最优的数据和模型配置。这是一个黑盒优化问题，贝叶斯优化（BO）通过依次评估训练配置，并利用观测到的性能反馈自适应地引导搜索走向更优配置来解决该问题。然而，直接将贝叶斯优化应用于数据-模型联合空间面临两个根本性挑战：每次迭代中进行完整LLM训练的高昂成本，以及由于问题维度过高而需要大量BO迭代才能实现有效探索。本文提出了JoBS，一种基于贝叶斯优化的方法，可以在无需每次迭代都进行完整训练的情况下协同优化数据和模型配置。JoBS将优化预算的初始部分用于学习一个受缩放定律启发的性能预测器，该预测器可以估计完全训练后的LLM性能……
tldr: 提出JoBS方法，利用受缩放定律启发的性能预测器结合贝叶斯优化，在无需每次迭代完整训练LLM的情况下，高效协同优化大语言模型的数据与模型配置。
en_tdlr: JoBS, a Bayesian optimization-based approach that leverages a scaling-law-inspired performance predictor to co-optimize data and model configurations for LLM fine-tuning without requiring a full training run at every iteration.
